en.Situation: In my first analyst role, the Monday sales dashboard showed higher revenue than finance, and nobody trusted it any more.
en.Task: I was asked to find out which number was wrong, and to explain it in a way the business side could follow.
en.Action: I compared row counts between the warehouse and the source system, found a join that duplicated refund lines, and rewrote the query with a deduplicated subquery.
en.Result: The dashboard matched finance to the cent, and the weekly meeting stopped questioning the numbers.
en.vague: The dashboard had some problems with the numbers for a while.
en.exaggerated: I found every data problem in the company and fixed the whole report suite.
en.no_data: After the fix the numbers looked right and people trusted the dashboard again.

zh.Situation: 第一份分析工作，星期一嘅 sales dashboard 收入比財務高，之後冇人信個報表。
zh.Task: 我要查出邊個數字錯，並用業務同事听得明嘅方式解釋。
zh.Action: 我比對倉庫同來源系統嘅筆數，發現一個 join 令退款行重複，再用去重 subquery 重寫條 query。
zh.Result: dashboard 同財務分毫不差，每週例會唔再質疑啲數字。
zh.vague: 個 dashboard 啲數字有段時間都幾有問題。
zh.exaggerated: 我搵出公司所有數據問題，仲修好晒成個報表系統。
zh.no_data: 修好之後啲數字睇落對，大家又開始信個 dashboard。

en.Situation: Two years in, the retention team kept asking why customers dropped off after the third order.
en.Task: I owned the analysis for that question, and I had to give them a finding they could act on within the quarter.
en.Action: I built a cohort view in SQL, split customers by first order month, and compared repeat rate by delivery district.
en.Result: One district had a repeat rate about half of the others, which led to a delivery partner change that quarter.
en.vague: We looked at retention for a bit but it was quite vague.
en.exaggerated: My analysis saved the company a large amount of money that year.
en.no_data: The retention picture became clearer and the team used it.

zh.Situation: 做咗兩年，retention 組不停問點解客人喺第三次落單之後就流失。
zh.Task: 我負責呢個分析，要喺季度內交到一個佢哋可以行動嘅結論。
zh.Action: 我用 SQL 做 cohort view，按首次落單月份分組，再比較唔同送貨區嘅回購率。
zh.Result: 有一個區嘅回購率大約係其他區嘅一半，結果嗰季就換咗送貨伙伴。
zh.vague: 我哋有睇過 retention，但都幾模糊。
zh.exaggerated: 我嘅分析幫公司慳咗一大筆錢。
zh.no_data: retention 嘅情況清楚咗，團隊都有用。

en.Situation: In a retail group, seven monthly reports were still built by hand in Excel and took a colleague two full days each month.
en.Task: I was given the migration to Tableau, and I had to keep the figures identical while changing the tool.
en.Action: I rebuilt each report, reconciled every total against the old file, and ran a short walkthrough for the people who used them.
en.Result: Refresh went from two days to a scheduled run, and the old file matched the new one on all seven reports.
en.vague: The monthly reports were manual and slow before.
en.exaggerated: I automated the entire reporting function of the company.
en.no_data: The reports refresh themselves now and people are used to it.

zh.Situation: 喺一間零售集團，七份月報仍然要人手用 Excel 做，同事每個月要花兩日。
zh.Task: 我接手搬去 Tableau，換工具之餘數字要完全一樣。
zh.Action: 我逐份重建，每個總數都同舊檔對一次，再同用報表嘅同事做一次簡短 walkthrough。
zh.Result: 更新由兩日變成排程執行，七份報表新舊檔數字全部對得上。
zh.vague: 之前月報要人手做，幾慢。
zh.exaggerated: 我自動化咗公司成個報表部門。
zh.no_data: 依家報表自己更新，同事都習慣咗。

en.Situation: Four years in, sales and finance argued for a month about whether revenue should count a booking at order date or delivery date.
en.Task: I had to settle one definition with both sides so that two teams stopped reporting different totals.
en.Action: I ran a short workshop, wrote each option with its effect on two sample months, and asked both leads to sign one line.
en.Result: We agreed on delivery date, and the two monthly packs reported the same revenue from the next month.
en.vague: There was a disagreement about how to count revenue.
en.exaggerated: I fixed the company's whole reporting argument in one meeting.
en.no_data: In the end both teams used the same definition.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，sales 同 finance 為收入應該按落單日定送貨日計，爭咗一個月。
zh.Task: 我要同兩邊定一個定義，令兩隊唔再報唔同總數。
zh.Action: 我開咗個短工作坊，把每個方案對兩個樣本月份嘅影響寫出嚟，再請兩位主管各簽一行字。
zh.Result: 最後定咗按送貨日計，下個月起兩份月報嘅收入一致。
zh.vague: 大家對點計收入有啲爭議。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個會就解決咗公司成個報表爭議。
zh.no_data: 最後兩隊都用同一個定義。

en.Situation: During my internship the stock report and the shop floor count disagreed by about two hundred items every week.
en.Task: I was asked to find the gap before the audit, and to keep the check repeatable afterwards.
en.Action: I wrote a reconciliation query that matched on item code and warehouse, then listed the unmatched rows for the store keeper to confirm.
en.Result: Most of the gap came from items booked under two codes, and the weekly difference dropped below ten.
en.vague: The stock figures did not match and it was confusing.
en.exaggerated: I solved the company's inventory problem completely during my internship.
en.no_data: The difference became much smaller after that.

zh.Situation: 實習時，庫存報表同舖面點數每星期差大約二百件。
zh.Task: 我要喺 audit 之前找出差距，並令呢個檢查之後可以重複做。
zh.Action: 我寫咗一條對帳 query，用 item code 加倉庫配對，再列出配唔到嘅行俾倉務同事確認。
zh.Result: 大部分差距來自同一件貨有兩個 code，每星期差異之後跌到十件以內。
zh.vague: 庫存數字對唔上，好混亂。
zh.exaggerated: 我實習期間完全解決咗公司嘅庫存問題。

en.Situation: Five years in, six colleagues kept sending me the same four ad-hoc questions every week and each took about an hour.
en.Task: I wanted the team to answer those questions without waiting for me, without losing control of the SQL.
en.Action: I saved each query as a parameterised view, wrote a one-page guide with an example, and ran a lunchtime session.
en.Result: Three of the four questions were answered in the team by the next month, which freed about four hours a week.
en.vague: People kept asking me the same questions and it was quite busy.
en.exaggerated: I turned the whole team into data analysts within a month.
en.no_data: After the session, fewer people asked me and it saved time.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，六位同事每星期都問同樣四個 ad-hoc 問題，每個要一個鐘。
zh.Task: 我想團隊可以自己答，但 SQL 仍然受控。
zh.Action: 我把每條 query 做成 parameterised view，寫一頁指南連例子，再開個午飯時間 session。
zh.Result: 下個月起四個問題有三個團隊自己答到，每星期省返大約四個鐘。
zh.vague: 同事不停問我同樣嘅問題，都幾忙。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個月內令成個團隊變晒數據分析師。
zh.no_data: session 之後少咗人問我，慳返啲時間。

en.Situation: At a bank's retail analytics team, the campaign list for a credit card promotion was pulled from three systems and 12 per cent of customers appeared twice.
en.Task: I owned the list build, and I had to decide whether to delay the send or ship a list I could not defend.
en.Action: I flagged the duplicate rate to the campaign owner, deduplicated on customer id with a documented rule, and gave them the count before and after.
en.Result: The send went out one day later with no duplicate mailers, and the rule was reused for the next two campaigns.
en.vague: The campaign list had some duplicates and we had to deal with it.
en.exaggerated: I rebuilt the entire customer database for the bank.
en.no_data: After the change the list was cleaner and the send went out.

zh.Situation: 喺銀行零售分析組，信用卡推廣嘅目標名單由三個系統抽出，有 12% 客人重複出現。
zh.Task: 我負責建名單，要決定係延遲發送，定係交一份自己都解釋唔到嘅名單。
zh.Action: 我向 campaign owner 報告重複率，用有記錄嘅規則按 customer id 去重，並交出前後數目。
zh.Result: 發送遲一日，但冇客人收到兩封，而個規則之後兩個 campaign 都照用。
zh.vague: 個名單有啲重複，我哋要處理。
zh.exaggerated: 我重建咗銀行成個客戶資料庫。
zh.no_data: 之後名單清潔咗，發送照出。

en.Situation: In my first month at a logistics company, the weekly delivery-time report showed a district with an average of minus two hours.
en.Task: I was asked to check the report before it went to the regional manager on Monday.
en.Action: I traced the timestamps, found that overnight deliveries crossed midnight and were subtracted the wrong way, and recalculated with a date-aware difference.
en.Result: The district average came back to a normal 38 hours, and I added a check for any negative duration in future runs.
en.vague: One number in the report looked odd so I looked into it.
en.exaggerated: I found a major flaw that the whole company had missed for years.
en.no_data: After the fix the number looked normal and the report went out.

zh.Situation: 入職第一個月，物流公司每週送貨時間報表出現一個區平均係負兩小時。
zh.Task: 我要喺星期一交去區域經理之前檢查清楚。
zh.Action: 我追時間戳，發現通宵送貨跨過午夜，相減方向錯咗，於是用識別日期嘅差值重算。
zh.Result: 該區平均變返正常嘅 38 小時，我仲加咗檢查，日後出現負時長就會報警。
zh.vague: 報表有個數字怪怪，我去睇下。
zh.exaggerated: 我發現咗一個公司多年都冇人見到嘅重大錯漏。
zh.no_data: 修好之後數字正常，報表照出。

en.Situation: Four years in, the sales director wanted a single funnel number for the board deck, but three teams counted a lead at different stages.
en.Task: I had to produce one number I could defend, and get the three team leads to use the same definition.
en.Action: I drew the three funnels side by side, showed the gap for two sample months, and proposed counting a lead at first contact.
en.Result: The board deck carried one number, and the three leads agreed the definition in the same meeting.
en.vague: The teams counted leads differently and it was confusing.
en.exaggerated: I ended all reporting differences in the sales department.
en.no_data: After the meeting everyone used the same number.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，銷售總監想要一個漏斗數字放入董事會 deck，但三隊人喺唔同階段計 lead。
zh.Task: 我要交一個解釋得到嘅數字，並令三位 team lead 用同一個定義。
zh.Action: 我把三個漏斗並排畫出，展示兩個樣本月份嘅差距，再建議以首次接觸計 lead。
zh.Result: 董事會 deck 只用一個數字，三位 lead 亦喺同一個會上同意定義。
zh.vague: 各隊計 lead 方法唔同，好混亂。
zh.exaggerated: 我令銷售部門所有報表差異消失。
zh.no_data: 開完會之後大家都用同一個數。

en.Situation: As an intern at a retailer, I was asked how many loyalty members had not bought anything for a year.
en.Task: It sounded like one query, but I had to check that the member and order tables joined on the right key first.
en.Action: I sampled twenty members by hand, compared them with the query output, and fixed the join that was dropping members without orders.
en.Result: The real figure was about twice my first answer, and the corrected query became the standard lapsed-member count.
en.vague: I did a query and the answer needed some checking.
en.exaggerated: I produced the definitive loyalty analysis for the whole company.
en.no_data: After the correction the number was higher and the team used it.

zh.Situation: 喺零售商實習，有人問我有幾多會員一年冇買過嘢。
zh.Task: 聽落只係一條 query，但我要先確認會員表同訂單表用啱 key join。
zh.Action: 我手動抽廿個會員核對 query 結果，發現個 join 漏咗冇訂單嘅會員，然後修好。
zh.Result: 真實數字大約係我第一次答案嘅兩倍，修正後嘅 query 成為標準嘅流失會員計法。
zh.vague: 我跑咗條 query，個答案要再檢查。
zh.exaggerated: 我做咗公司權威嘅會員分析。
zh.no_data: 修正之後數字高咗，團隊有採用。

en.Situation: A shop manager insisted his branch was underperforming because of the location, and asked me to confirm it.
en.Task: I had to answer honestly, which meant checking whether the numbers supported his story before I agreed with him.
en.Action: I compared his branch with three similar ones by footfall band, and found his conversion rate was the outlier, not the traffic.
en.Result: He stopped blaming the location and asked for help with staff rostering instead.
en.vague: The manager had a theory about why his branch was weak.
en.exaggerated: I proved the manager completely wrong in front of his boss.
en.no_data: After the comparison the conversation moved on to something more useful.

zh.Situation: 有位店長堅持佢間分店表現差係因為位置，叫我幫佢確認。
zh.Task: 我要老實答，即係要先睇數字有冇支持佢嘅講法，然後才同意。
zh.Action: 我按人流級別同三間類似分店比較，發現問題係佢嘅轉換率，而唔係人流。
zh.Result: 佢唔再怪位置，反而問我幫手睇排班。
zh.vague: 個店長對分店表現有自己一套講法。
zh.exaggerated: 我喺佢老闆面前證明佢完全錯。
zh.no_data: 比較完之後，討論轉去更有用嘅方向。

en.Situation: Five years in at a hospital group, the management wanted a monthly report on clinic waiting time but no team owned the source data.
en.Task: I agreed to build the first version, on the condition that we wrote down who owns each field.
en.Action: I met the clinic supervisors, mapped each field to a system, and marked the four fields nobody could confirm as unknown.
en.Result: The report shipped with four fields marked unknown instead of invented, and the supervisors fixed two of them the next month.
en.vague: We needed a waiting-time report and the data was unclear.
en.exaggerated: I delivered a complete clinical analytics platform by myself.
en.no_data: The report went out and the supervisors gradually filled the gaps.

zh.Situation: 喺一個醫療集團做咗五年，管理層想每月有診所等候時間報告，但冇團隊擁有來源數據。
zh.Task: 我同意做第一版，條件係要寫清楚每個欄位邊個負責。
zh.Action: 我同診所主管開會，把每個欄位對應到一個系統，四個冇人確認得到嘅欄位就標明 unknown。
zh.Result: 報告帶住四個 unknown 出街而唔係作數，主管下個月補返其中兩個。
zh.vague: 我哋要一份等候時間報告，但數據唔清楚。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人交咗一個完整嘅臨床分析平台。
zh.no_data: 報告出咗，主管慢慢補返啲缺口。
